description: Use this skill when building, reviewing, or refreshing a RACI (Responsible / Accountable / Consulted / Informed) matrix for a Salesforce project so that every Salesforce-specific decision — data model change, automation tier choice, security model, integration boundary, deployment, license/edition — has exactly one accountable owner and a documented escalation path that downstream agents can route to. Trigger keywords: RACI matrix salesforce project, stakeholder authority salesforce, escalation path salesforce decisions, who approves data model change, salesforce decision rights, REFUSAL_NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW routing. NOT for the change advisory board operating model itself (use admin/change-management-and-deployment). NOT for end-user training rollout plans (use admin/change-management-and-training). NOT for the technical mechanics of permission set assignment authority (use admin/permission-set-architecture). NOT for pure stakeholder requirements elicitation (use admin/requirements-gathering-for-sf). More trigger keywords: who approves a sandbox refresh, who signs off a data load, release update activation owner, delegated admin authority vs RACI, multi-org decision rights, escalation time-box.
inputs: Project phase (discovery, build, UAT, hypercare) and target go-live date
Org topology — single org, multi-org, M&A, regulated industry context

Roster of named individuals or roles filling: business sponsor, process owner, data steward, security architect, integration architect, CRM admin lead, release manager, compliance officer, AppExchange owner, end-user representative
List of Salesforce decision categories in scope (data model, automation, security, integration, deployment, licensing)
Existing change advisory board (CAB) cadence and quorum rules, if any
name: stakeholder-raci-for-sf-projects
official_sources: Salesforce Well-Architected Overview — https://architect.salesforce.com/docs/architect/well-architected/guide/overview.html — Frames the four lenses (Trusted, Easy, Adaptable, Sustainable) the RACI must support.

Salesforce Well-Architected — Trusted / Compliant — https://architect.salesforce.com/well-architected/trusted/compliant — Authoritative for the compliance officer's role on regulated data and the audit-trail / retention rows.

Salesforce Well-Architected — Trusted / Secure — https://architect.salesforce.com/well-architected/trusted/secure — Authoritative for the security architect's A on the sharing-model row and the split between security and integration architecture.

Salesforce Well-Architected — Adaptable / Resilient — https://architect.salesforce.com/well-architected/adaptable/resilient — Authoritative for release manager / CAB pattern on the deployment, hotfix, and release-update rows.

Metadata API Developer Guide, `DelegateGroup` — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_meta.pdf — File suffix `.delegateGroup` in `delegateGroups`, API v36.0+, "View Setup and Configuration" required to be a delegated admin, assignable profiles / permission sets / permission set groups, `loginAccess` semantics, and the limits on what a delegated admin may do to custom objects (`worked-examples.md` §6; `gotchas.md` §10, §14, §15).

Metadata API Developer Guide, `CustomMetadata` and `CustomMetadataValue` — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_meta.pdf — Suffix `.md` in `customMetadata`, API v31.0+, "Customize Application" to create records, record naming, `xsi:type` mapping, omitted-vs-null value semantics, and protected-record visibility (`worked-examples.md` §7, decision-log-as-metadata).

Metadata API Developer Guide, org settings that correspond to Release Updates — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_meta.pdf — `FlowSettings.doesEnforceApexCpuTimeLimit` and `MyDomainSettings.useStabilizedSandboxMyDomainHostnames` (enforced Summer '20; value always `true` as of API v49.0 regardless of what you set) — evidence that release-update state is deployable metadata and not always reversible (`gotchas.md` §12).

Apex Developer Guide, Executing Anonymous Apex — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/salesforce_apex_developer_guide.pdf — The worked shape of a Release Update: a restriction available to subscribers in one release and enforced in a later one (`gotchas.md` §12; the release-update-activation row).

Object Reference, `DevopsEnvironment` — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/object_reference.pdf — `OrgIdentifier`, `RefreshDate`, and `RefreshSourceId`: a refreshed sandbox is detected as a different org and work items can be missing from it (`gotchas.md` §9, the sandbox-refresh-approval row).

Object Reference, `UserLicense` — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/object_reference.pdf — `LicenseDefinitionKey` values (`SFDC` = Full CRM, `AUL` = Salesforce Platform), `TotalLicenses` / `UsedLicenses` (API v32.0+, `UsedLicenses` not filterable in a `WHERE` clause from v64.0) — the register's licence column and its verification query (`worked-examples.md` §1, §7).

Data Loader Guide, Bulk API options — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/salesforce_data_loader.pdf — Hard-deleted records are removed immediately and cannot be recovered from the Recycle Bin (`gotchas.md` §13, the data-load-approval row).

Bulk API 2.0 Developer Guide, Understanding Bulk API 2.0 Ingest — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/api_asynch.pdf — One batch per 10,000 records up to 150,000,000 records per day; a batch that cannot complete in five minutes fails, is retried up to 20 times, then fails the job leaving data unprocessed (`gotchas.md` §11, §13).

Salesforce App Limits Cheat Sheet — https://resources.docs.salesforce.com/262/latest/en-us/sfdc/pdf/salesforce_app_limits_cheatsheet.pdf — Full Sandbox API allocation of 5,000,000 calls per 24 hours for sandboxes not created from a template, and the 25 concurrent long-running request limit for production orgs and sandboxes (`gotchas.md` §9, §11).

`agents/_shared/AGENT_CONTRACT.md` — the Citations block and confidence score every run-time agent must produce, which is what makes agent output attachable as decision-log evidence (`worked-examples.md` §5).
`agents/_shared/REFUSAL_CODES.md` — the refusal-code enum the `refusal_code_map` routes (`SKILL.md` § Mapping RACI to Agent Refusal Codes).

`standards/decision-trees/sharing-selection.md`, `automation-selection.md`, `integration-pattern-selection.md` — the trees the sharing, automation, and integration A cells consult before deciding; the matrix records who decides, the tree records how.
outputs: Filled RACI matrix as markdown table and machine-readable JSON (one row per decision category, one column per stakeholder role)
Per-row escalation rule with time-box and trigger condition (when does this go up, to whom, within how long)
Refusal-code-to-stakeholder map that downstream runtime agents can consult when they emit REFUSAL_NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW
Sponsor / steerco review log showing the matrix has been reviewed and version-locked for the current phase
Identified gaps — decision categories with no A, A roles overloaded across rows, decisions still owned by the consulting partner instead of the customer
